name: Automatic Data Processing
description: ADP runs payroll, tax, benefits, time and HR software for employers, charged per employee per pay period. Its second engine is float: it holds client payroll and tax money between collection and payout and invests it, earning $1.35 billion of interest on an average $40.4 billion of client funds at 3.4 percent in FY2026. Its PEO (professional employer organization) segment co-employs worksite employees and passes their benefits costs through at zero margin, which inflates revenue: $4.6 billion of the $21.9 billion total is pass-through. Pretax profit is concentrated in Employer Services (36.7 percent margin versus 13.1 percent for PEO).

sub.name: Payroll, HR, uniforms and route services

businessLines.name: Employer Services
businessLines.how: Recurring per-employee-per-pay-period fees for payroll, HR and time software and outsourcing, plus interest earned on client funds held between collection and payout.

businessLines.how: Fee per worksite employee for co-employment (HR, payroll, benefits administration) plus pass-through of benefit premiums at zero margin ($4,607.3M); only about $2.52B of the $7.13B is non-pass-through revenue.
